To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have studied the tubular bound state of a D2 brane with D0 branes and strings in various backgrounds and have found the stable tubular configurations of (nFs,mD0,D2) in the NS5 brane, D6 brane and macroscopic string background, the tubular configurations of nFc and mD0 in the D6 brane background, and that of mD0, mD0 and D2 in the macroscopic string background.

the D2-branes can bind to D0-branes or to fundamental strings in the background of macroscopic strings, D6-branes or NS5-branes, and the bound states are stable against collapse in the first two backgrounds.

we have found stable tubular bound state solutions in the NS5- brane background, D6-branes background and the macroscopic strings backgrounds, which are prevented from collapse by the angular momenta or the gravitational force.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the tubular bound state configurations of D-branes and fundamental strings, which may have potential applications in the string theory and AdS/CFT correspondence.
the stability and supersymmetry of tubular solutions in different background branes or strings.
the tubular bound state of a D2 with m D0 and n fundamental strings, which are in the background of the NS5-branes, Dp-branes and macroscopic strings.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the tubular configurations of (nFs,mD0,D2), (nFc,mD0,D4), (nFc, D2) or (nFc, 0) in the NS5- or D6-brane background, and the tubular configuration of (mD0,D2) in the D6-brane or the macroscopic strings backgrounds could be formed and are stable.
the tubular bound state of (nFc,mD0,D2) and (nFc,mF0, D2,D2) in the D6-brane background is stable.

the tubular configurations of a D2 with m D0 and n fundamental strings are unstable in flat space and in D2 and D4-branes backgrounds, stable in D6-branes, and a BPS configuration in the macroscopic string background.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the tubular bound state of D2-brane, D0-brane and Fc-string is the only one which could be stable in all the backgrounds we studied.
the tubular bound state of D-brane with fundamental strings is stable in some backgrounds, but unstable in other.
the existence of stable tubular solutions of (nFs,mD0,D2) in the backgrounds of macroscopic strings and D6-brane is a non-trivial result.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tubular solutions of (nFc,mD0,D2) and (nFc,m D0,D2), which are stable in the flat space and D6-brane background, are also stable in the NS5- and D4-branes background.

the tubular bound state solutions of (nFc,mD0,D2) and (nFs, D2) in the NS5- brane background, which are stable and supersymmetric, may be the microscopic origin for the macroscopic strings and the macroscopic string solutions of (nFm, mD0) in the D2- brane background may be the microscopic origins for the macroscopic Dp-branes.
tubular solutions of D2-brane, m D0-brane and n fundamental strings can be formed in the backgrounds of NS5-brane and macroscopics strings.
